text:
Lena (CEO): Thanks for the great questions in today's all-hands. Opening this thread for quick clarifications on mission, roadmap, and how we position vs competitors. Drop short Qs.

Meera (Product): Quick Q: when we say 'production-first', can marketing use that phrase externally or is it internal shorthand?

Rafael (CTO): short: use it externally but pair with concrete proof points (SLA numbers, batching/kv cache savings) 10s of words alone don't land.

Priya (Growth): For positioning copy: do we call out "predictable unit economics" or is that too niche for top-of-funnel?

Lena (CEO): Call it out in mid-funnel. Top-of-funnel: "fast to integrate" + "consistent performance". Mid: economics and ops controls.

Jon (Eng): Roadmap ask: will runtime v2 (attention opt) be in Hosted first or Dedicated first? Any rough ETA?

Rafael (CTO): Hosted first, then Dedicated/Private after validation. ETA for beta: ~8 weeks. Will post release date in eng-runtime.

Kai (Research): Competitor angle: do we maintain a public benchmark repo? we agreed anonymized numbers last meeting.

Meera (Product): yes 1 we will publish a reproducible benchmarks repo (anonymized) plus a methodology doc. ETA next week.

Priya (Growth): Sales asked for a one-liner differentiator vs cloud vendors. Any suggested line?

Lena (CEO): Suggested: "Redwood makes inference predictable and economical at production scale 1 across hosted, reserved, and private deployments." Feel free to tighten.

doc-bot: Reminder: Meera uploaded the parity checklist draft to /docs/internal/positioning.

Meera (Product): I'll post the 2-paragraph press blurb and the sales one-pager here by EOD. Tagging @Priya @Rafael.

Lena (CEO): Great. If no other Qs, we'll close updates to this thread as artifacts land. :sparkles:
